title: A company focused on photonic questions
description: Artifactory presents ArtiSense and AIFIELD as two current projects: one investigates sensing, the other supports photonic engineering. This draft describes their focus without inventing a team roster or legal history.

sections.heading: Why these projects sit together
body: A sensing concept needs both an understanding of light interacting with matter and a way to design photonic components. AIFIELD’s engineering workflow may be relevant to ArtiSense designs, but the projects retain separate goals and evidence.

sections.heading: What we can say today
body: The supplied context identifies the project subjects and a September 2026 research snapshot. It does not confirm biographies, team size, incorporation details, patents, ownership or partnerships. Those facts should be added only after direct owner review.

sections.heading: How to get in touch
body: Investors can ask about the company-level opportunity and current stage; technical partners can propose a focused discussion. The local form is a preview test channel and the email alternative opens your own mail client.
